Healing Aura Beginning at 15th level, You can now create a healing aura for 30 ft. An ally(including yourself) in the aura heals for 5 + proficiency bonus hp per round while inside, once they leave the aura the effect is no longer with them.
Sacrificing Stab Beginning at 19th level, you can sacrifice yourself to allow any ally to regain all of their hit points. This action will put you at 1 hit point and you become unconscious.

Variant Fighter The Style of Dragons Who Want Power.
Your carrying capacity (including maximum load and maximum lift) is doubled and you have advantage on Strength checks made to push, pull, lift, or break objects.
Draconic Strike Choose a damage type between fire and cold. Beginning at 3rd level, you add 1d4 damage of the chosen type to your attacks. The damage increases by one die at 12th level (1d6), and at 17th (1d8).
Master of the Element Beginning at the 6th level, while raging you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
Breath of the Dragon Beginning at 8th level, you can make an Draconic breath attack of the chosen type. The breath weapon is a 15' cone (fire or cold) The DC for the breath attack is 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes 5d6 damage on a failed save and half as much damage on a successful save. You can use this ability twice after which you need to finish a short rest before you can use this feature again.
Improved Draconic Persistance Beginning at 11th level, you can count any immunity against your dragon type as resistance and resistance as normal.
Improved Draconic Strike Beginning at 15th level, increase the die of your Draconic Strike by one.
Draconic Fury Beginning at 19th level, you have mastered the ability to channel your chosen element into your attacks. Once per long rest, you deal 6d8 damage of the chosen element in addition to your weapon damage.

711.d: The Espada is a specialized prestige class designed as the absolute pinnacle of evolution for the Hollow race. These are not merely Arrancars who have broken their masks; they are the ten crowns of Hueco Mundo, beings who have refined their primitive, monstrous hunger into a sovereign authority that can challenge the heavens. …
f: Spiritual Reservoir

Starting at 1st level, your existence is fueled by Reishi, the spiritual particles that make up the atmosphere of Hueco Mundo. You possess a pool of Reiryoku points equal to your Charisma modifier + five times your Espada level (minimum 10). These points are the fuel for your Ceros, Sonído, Hierro, and other abilities. You regain all spent Reiryoku after a long rest and half after a short rest. At the start of each of your turns in combat, you naturally siphon energy from the air, regaining Reiryoku points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). …
Zanpakutō Awakening

At 1st level, you have successfully sealed your original, monstrous Hollow power into the form of a sword. This weapon is an extension of your soul. You use your Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls with your Zanpakutō. The weapon deals 1d10 slashing damage and has the Finesse property. Due to the spiritual pressure radiating from the blade, it distorts the air around it, granting you a natural Reach of 10 feet. You cannot be disarmed of this weapon unless you are incapacitated. …
Pesquisa Vision

Your spiritual senses are refined to a supernatural degree. You can "see" the spiritual pressure (Reiatsu) of any creature within 120 feet, even through walls, total darkness, or magical invisibility. This allows you to immediately know a creature's current hit points and their highest and lowest ability score modifiers. You have advantage on Perception and Insight checks against any creature that possesses a soul. Additionally, you can use a bonus action to focus your Pesquisa on one creature within range, learning any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities it has.
Spiritual Recovery

Also at 1st level, your connection to the ambient Reishi allows for rapid recovery. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points during a short rest, you can roll it twice and take the better result. Once per long rest, if you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead.
Hierro Refinement

Starting at 2nd level, your skin becomes as hard as the armor of a Menos Grande. While you are not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 13 + your Constitution modifier + half your Proficiency bonus (rounded down). This skin, known as Hierro, is dense enough to deflect blades and ignore minor spells. As a reaction when you are hit by a weapon attack, you can spend 2 Reiryoku to increase your AC against that attack by your Constitution modifier, potentially causing it to miss. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per short rest.
Bala-Blade Arts

From 2nd level, you can infuse your sword swings with the Bala technique—a concentrated bullet of spiritual pressure. When you make an attack with your Zanpakutō, you can choose to project a wave of force. This allows your melee weapon attacks to hit targets up to 60 feet away. These attacks deal force damage instead of slashing damage and are treated as melee weapon attacks for all purposes. As a bonus action, you can spend 3 Reiryoku to make a special Bala attack. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 feet. …
Sonído

At 2nd level, you master the high-speed movement technique of the Arrancar. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. Additionally, you can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action on your turn. When you take the Dash action, you can move through the space of any creature that is your size or smaller without treating it as difficult terrain, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to avoid opportunity attacks triggered by this movement. You can spend 1 Reiryoku for every 10 feet of extra movement beyond your speed on your turn, up to a maximum of 100 extra feet.
Cero

At 3rd level, you learn to focus your immense Reiatsu into a devastating beam of destruction. As an action, you can spend 10 Reiryoku to fire a Cero in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). A creature takes 6d6 force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (7d6), 11th level (8d6), and 17th level (9d6). …
Caja Negación

Also at 3rd level, you gain a unique emergency tool. You possess a single, ornate box called a Caja Negación. As an action, you can throw it at a point within 60 feet. Upon landing, it erupts into a 20-foot-radius cube of distorted space for 1 minute. Any creature inside the cube when it forms, or who enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be trapped inside an extradimensional space. …
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As an Espada, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature. (These are the levels for **Inclemento**.)
Biological Reconstruction

Starting at 4th level, your Reishi is so dense that your body automatically mends itself. You gain a pool of Regeneration Dice (d8s) equal to your proficiency bonus. As a bonus action on your turn, you can spend one or more dice to heal yourself. Roll the dice, add your Constitution modifier, and regain hit points equal to the total. You regain all expended dice after a long rest. Furthermore, if you lose a limb or organ, it regrows over the course of a short rest, provided you have at least 1 hit point.
Spiritual Domination

Beginning at 5th level, your Reiatsu passively asserts dominance over weaker souls. Any creature with a Challenge Rating lower than your Espada level that starts its turn within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become Frightened of you until the start of its next turn. Creatures with an Intelligence score of 4 or lower automatically fail this save. You can choose to suppress or activate this aura as a free action.
Command of Menos

Also at 5th level, your authority over lesser Hollows is absolute. You can use an action to issue a telepathic command to any number of Hollow, Menos, or Gillian-type creatures within 1 mile. The creatures understand your command and will follow it to the best of their ability for the next 24 hours, provided the command is not obviously self-destructive. You can have a number of such creatures under your command equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) at any one time.
Gemelos Sonído

At 6th level, your mastery of Sonído allows you to create afterimages. When you take the Dash action, you can spend 5 Reiryoku to create one illusory duplicate of yourself in a space you occupied this turn. The duplicate lasts until the start of your next turn. The first time a creature targets you with an attack, it must roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the attack targets the duplicate instead, destroying it. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Hierro Adaptativo

Also at 6th level, your Hierro learns from past assaults. Whenever you take damage from a weapon or spell, you can use your reaction to spend 3 Reiryoku. You gain resistance to that specific damage type (e.g., fire, slashing) until the end of your next turn. If you use this feature again before the resistance ends, the previous resistance ends.
High-Speed Regeneration

Starting at 7th level, your Biological Reconstruction accelerates. When you use your Regeneration Dice, you can roll a d4 and add it to the number of dice you regain at the end of a long rest (up to your maximum). Additionally, if you are below half your hit point maximum at the start of your turn, you regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1).
Cero Tuning

At 7th level, your mastery over the Cero becomes surgical. When you cast your Cero, you can spend 5 additional Reiryoku to alter its shape and property.
Cero Cone:
The blast erupts in a 30-foot cone.
Cero Nova:
A 15-foot radius burst centered on a point within 60 feet.
Elemental Shift:
You can change the damage type of your Cero to Fire, Cold, Lightning, or Necrotic.
Soul Resistance

Also at 7th level, your dense spiritual body resists external manipulation. You have advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that would banish you to another plane, trap your soul, or change your form (such as *banishment*, *magic jar*, or *polymorph*).
Enduring Hierro Plating

At 8th level, your Hierro grants you resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Additionally, your Hierro Refinement AC calculation improves, now equaling 14 + your Constitution modifier + half your Proficiency bonus.
Gran Rey Cero

At 9th level, you unlock the forbidden Cero of the Espada. As an action, you can spend 25 Reiryoku to fire a Gran Rey Cero. Choose a 30-foot-radius sphere within 120 feet. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 force damage and is blinded until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't blinded. The space within the sphere becomes difficult terrain filled with crackling Reiatsu for 1 minute. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
Zanpakutō Arts: Ryodan

Also at 9th level, you learn a devastating sword technique. When you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your attacks to perform Ryodan (Cleaving Strike). Make a single melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 4d8 slashing damage, and if the creature is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be knocked prone. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Pesquisa: Fatal Flaw

At 9th level, your Pesquisa Vision pierces to the core weakness of any soul. As an action, you can focus on one creature you can see within 120 feet. You learn one vulnerability it has. If it has no vulnerability, you instead learn one of its resistances or immunities becomes neutralized for you for 1 minute. The next time you hit that creature with an attack before this effect ends, your attack ignores the chosen resistance or immunity. You can use this feature once per short or long rest.
Resurrección

At 10th level, you can release your true power by speaking your Zanpakutō's release command. As a bonus action, you can spend 15 Reiryoku to enter your Resurrección form for 1 minute. You gain the following benefits:
Your Charisma and Constitution scores increase by 2, to a maximum of 22.
Your weapon transforms, its damage die increases to 1d12, and it gains an additional property (reach, thrown, etc.) thematic to your Aspect.
You gain temporary hit points equal to your Espada level × 2 at the start of each of your turns.
You gain a unique, powerful feature granted by your Aspect of Death. …
Enhanced Reiryoku Flow

Also at 10th level, your spiritual energy flows more freely. The maximum Reiryoku you can spend on a single Cero increases by 10. Additionally, when you regain Reiryoku at the start of your turn, you regain additional points equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down).
Descorrer

At 11th level, you can create dimensional doors with a gesture. As an action, you can spend 10 Reiryoku to create a portal to a location you have seen before on the same plane of existence. The portal is large enough for you and any creatures within 5 feet of you to step through, arriving within 10 feet of the desired location. The portal lasts for 1 round. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Spatial Distortion

Also at 11th level, you can warp space defensively. When a creature you can see targets you with an attack, you can use your reaction to spend 5 Reiryoku. You twist the space around you, imposing disadvantage on the attack roll. If the attack still hits, you have resistance to the damage from that attack.
Garganta

At 11th level, you perfect the ability to tear open the fabric of reality. As an action, you can spend 15 Reiryoku to open a Garganta—a black, jagged rift in space. You can use this to travel between any of the primary planes (Hueco Mundo, Material Plane, Soul Society, etc.), with the journey taking 1d4 hours. In combat, you can use the Garganta as an action to teleport up to 500 feet to a space you can see. Any creature other than you that enters or starts its turn in the space where the Garganta opens or closes must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 6d10 force damage.
Unwavering Soul Anchor

At 12th level, your soul is incredibly bound to your body. You have advantage on death saving throws. Additionally, if you would be killed by an effect that destroys your body (like *disintegrate*), you can spend 30 Reiryoku as a reaction. Your body collapses into Reishi, which reforms at the start of your next turn in the same space with 1 hit point, provided your soul has not been trapped or destroyed.
Hierro Elemental Adaptation

Starting at 13th level, your Hierro Adaptativo feature improves. The resistance you gain lasts for 1 minute. Furthermore, you are permanently resistant to two damage types of your choice from the following: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. You can change these chosen resistances when you finish a long rest.
Unshakable Will

Also at 13th level, your mind is a fortress. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, or stunned. If you succeed on such a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against the source of the effect, provided it is within your reach.
Resurrección Mastery

At 14th level, you can maintain your Resurrección form longer and recover it faster. The duration of your Resurrección extends to 10 minutes. Additionally, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Resurrección remaining, you regain one use.
Prolonged Release

Also at 14th level, you can tap into a fraction of your released power without full transformation. As a bonus action, you can spend 5 Reiryoku to enter a "Pseudo-Resurrección" for 1 minute. While in this state, your Zanpakutō gains the benefits of your 10th-level Resurrección transformation (increased damage die, thematic property), but you do not gain the ability score increases, temporary hit points, or unique Aspect feature. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Soul Crush

Beginning at 15th level, your mere Reiatsu can extinguish weaker souls. As an action, you can unleash a wave of crushing spiritual pressure in a 60-foot radius centered on yourself. Each creature of your choice in that area must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). A creature takes 10d10 psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature once per short or long rest.
Zanpakutō: Soul Pulse

Also at 15th level, your weapon resonates with your soul. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with your Zanpakutō, you can cause the blade to pulse with Reiatsu. The target takes extra force damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can choose one of the following effects: **Disrupt:** The target has disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of your next turn. **Drain:** You regain Reiryoku equal to half the extra force damage dealt (rounded down).
Regeneration Overdrive

At 16th level, your Biological Reconstruction can be pushed to its limits. As a bonus action, you can spend 2 Regeneration Dice to end one of the following conditions on yourself: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. Additionally, when you use your High-Speed Regeneration to regain hit points at the start of your turn, you regain additional hit points equal to your Espada level.
Transcendent Reiatsu

Starting at 17th level, your spiritual pressure transcends normal limits. Your Charisma score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22. Your Reiryoku pool maximum increases by an amount equal to your Espada level. Additionally, creatures that are immune to the frightened condition are not immune to your Spiritual Domination feature, though they have advantage on the saving throw.
Total Regeneration

Also at 17th level, your body can regenerate from near-total destruction. If you have at least 1 Reiryoku point when you die, you don't die immediately. Instead, you fall into a dormant state for 1 hour, appearing as a crumbling mask or a core of Reishi. If your dormant form isn't destroyed within that hour, you return to life with hit points equal to half your hit point maximum. Once this feature is used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
Cero Oscuras

At 18th level, you master the ultimate Cero of the Vasto Lorde. As an action, you can spend 40 Reiryoku to fire a Cero Oscuras. It functions as the Gran Rey Cero (30-foot-radius sphere, 120-foot range), but its damage increases to 15d10 necrotic damage. Additionally, a creature that fails its saving throw has its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. …
Reiatsu Solidification

Also at 18th level, your spiritual pressure can manifest physically. As a bonus action, you can spend Reiryoku to create simple objects or weapons out of solidified Reiatsu. These objects last for 1 hour. You can also create a stationary, transparent wall of force, up to 10 feet square per 5 Reiryoku spent, within 30 feet. The wall lasts for 10 minutes, has AC 15 and hit points equal to 10 times the Reiryoku spent to create it, and is immune to psychic and poison damage.
Perfected Hierro Shell

At 19th level, your Hierro becomes nearly impregnable. You gain immunity to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Your Hierro Refinement AC calculation improves once more, now equaling 15 + your Constitution modifier + half your Proficiency bonus. Additionally, you have resistance to force damage.
Resurrección: Segunda Etapa

At 20th level, you achieve a release beyond release—a second stage of Resurrección that only a handful of Espada ever attain. As a bonus action while in your Resurrección form, you can spend 30 Reiryoku to enter your Segunda Etapa. The transformation lasts for 1 minute and grants the following benefits, which replace your normal Resurrección benefits:
Your Charisma and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 24.
Your weapon damage die increases to 2d8 (or 3d6 if it already had a d12), and you gain a second thematic property. …
Aspect Embodiment

Also at 20th level, you become the living incarnation of your Aspect of Death. You gain a permanent, thematic physical change (wings of shadow, a crown of bone, skin like cracked magma, etc.). You are permanently under the effects of your 13th-level Aspect feature (if it had a duration). Additionally, once per long rest, when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can choose to instead drop to 1 hit point and immediately activate your Resurrección: Segunda Etapa without spending Reiryoku or an action, even if you have already used it.

sub.n: Aspect of Loneliness (Primera Espada: Coyote Starrk)
sub.d:
Soul Fragment At 3rd level, your solitude physically splits your soul. You create a loyal companion called a Fraction. It uses the statistics of a **Specter** (Monster Manual, p. 279), but with the following changes:
It has hit points equal to five times your Espada level.
It adds your Charisma modifier to its attack and damage rolls.
It shares your initiative and obeys your mental commands (no action required).
It is considered a creature under your control.
While your Fraction is within 30 feet of you, you gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class and all saving throws. If your Fraction is destroyed, it dissipates into Reishi. You can re-manifest it with 1 hit point after finishing a short or long rest.
Cero Metralleta At 6th level, you can unleash a storm of spiritual energy. As an action, you can spend 30 Reiryoku to fire a barrage of a thousand Ceros. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 force damage, or half as much on a successful one. This damage ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance.
Los Lobos At 10th level, your Resurrección unleashes the wolves of solitude. When you activate your Resurrección, you summon a number of spiritual wolves equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 3). As a bonus action on your turn, you can command up to two wolves. …

sub.n: Aspect of Senescence (Segunda Espada: Baraggan Louisenbairn)
sub.d:
Aura of Decay At 3rd level, an aura of accelerated time emanates from you. As an action, you can spend 5 Reiryoku to activate a 10-foot-radius aura for 1 minute. Any non-magical object that enters the aura instantly ages into dust. A creature that ends its turn in the aura must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 necrotic damage and have its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
Respira At 6th level, you exhale a cloud of absolute rot. As an action, you can spend 15 Reiryoku to release a 30-foot cone of black mist. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 6d8 necrotic damage, and its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest.
Gran Caída At 10th level, your Resurrección weapon is a massive axe of decay. Its attacks deal an extra 2d8 necrotic damage. When you hit a creature with it, you can spend 5 Reiryoku to force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is paralyzed as its body rapidly ages, until the end of your next turn.
Arrogante del Tiempo At 13th level, your Aura of Decay expands to a 15-foot radius, and its damage increases to 3d6. Additionally, you are immune to effects that would age you magically or prematurely, and you have resistance to necrotic damage.
Rey de la Tumba At 17th level, you can unleash the full weight of time. …

sub.n: Aspect of Sacrifice (Tercera Espada: Tier Harribel)
sub.d:
Water's Embrace At 3rd level, you command the water in the atmosphere. You can cast the create or destroy water and fog cloud spells at will, without material components, using Charisma. As an action, you can spend 5 Reiryoku to summon a wave that crashes in a 15-foot cube within 60 feet. Creatures in the area must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and take 2d6 bludgeoning damage.
Tiburón's Domain At 6th level, when you enter your Resurrección, you gain a swim speed of 60 feet, can breathe underwater, and all water within 30 feet of you is under your control. It is difficult terrain for enemies but not for you or your allies. Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d8 cold damage.
La Gota At 10th level, you can sacrifice your own power to empower others. As an action, you can shatter a symbolic part of your Zanpakutō (once per long rest). Choose up to three allies within 30 feet. They regain hit points equal to your Espada level × 5 and gain a +2 bonus to AC and damage rolls for 1 minute. For the duration, your own damage dealt is reduced by half.
Marejada At 13th level, your control over water becomes torrential. You can cast control water and water wall (as wall of fire, but cold damage and difficult terrain) once each per long rest without spending Reiryoku. Your Water's Embrace wave now deals 4d6 damage and restrains creatures on a failed save.
Tridente de Neptuno At 17th level, you summon a trident of solidified water. …

sub.n: Aspect of Emptiness (Cuarta Espada: Ulquiorra Cifer)
sub.d:
Cold Logic At 3rd level, your void of emotion grants immunity to being frightened or charmed. You gain proficiency in Intelligence saving throws and expertise in Insight and Investigation.
Luz de la Luna At 6th level, as an action, you can spend 10 Reiryoku to conjure and hurl a javelin of green energy. Make a ranged spell attack (range 120/300 ft). On a hit, it deals 4d10 force damage. You can choose to have it explode on impact in a 20-foot-radius sphere, forcing creatures in the area to make a Dexterity saving throw for half damage.
Segunda Etapa At 10th level, your Resurrección has a hidden, more powerful form. When you use your Resurrección feature, you can choose to enter your Segunda Etapa immediately, using its 20th-level class feature benefits but with a duration of 1 minute and only once per long rest. Your form becomes demonic, gaining bat-like wings and a tail.
Regeneration Nihil At 13th level, your attacks carry the concept of negation. When you damage a creature, any regeneration or healing it receives before the start of your next turn is reduced to 0. Additionally, you are immune to necrotic damage.
Lanza del Relámpago At 17th level, you forge a spear of void lightning. As an action, you can spend 50 Reiryoku to create and throw it at a point within 300 feet. Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 20d12 force damage and is blinded for 1 minute. …

sub.n: Aspect of Despair (Quinta Espada: Nnoitra Gilga)
sub.d:
Unkillable Brute At 3rd level, your hit point maximum increases by twice your Espada level. When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can use your reaction to spend 10 Reiryoku to drop to 1 hit point instead. You have advantage on death saving throws.
Santa Teresa At 6th level, your Resurrección grants you four additional arms, each wielding a spiritual scythe. You gain one additional attack whenever you take the Attack action. As an action, you can make a single attack roll against a creature within your reach. If it hits, you strike with all weapons at once, dealing your normal weapon damage for each.
Path of Pain At 10th level, your attacks inflict mental anguish. When you hit a creature, you can spend 5 Reiryoku to force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is afflicted with despair for 1 minute. A despairing creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and whenever it takes damage, it takes an extra 1d6 psychic damage.
Cero de la Desesperación At 13th level, your Cero carries psychic torment. When a creature fails its saving throw against your Cero, it takes an extra 4d6 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move its speed away from you.
Último Ritual At 17th level, you embrace a final, suicidal explosion of power. As an action when below half your hit points, you can choose to detonate your spiritual core. …

sub.n: Aspect of Destruction (Sexta Espada: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez)
sub.d:
Brutal Combatant At 3rd level, you use Charisma for Strength checks and saving throws. When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can spend 5 Reiryoku to attempt to knock it prone. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and pushed 15 feet away from you.
Desgarrón At 6th level, as a bonus action, you can spend 10 Reiryoku to manifest ten energy claws for 1 minute. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d8 slashing damage, you have a reach of 15 feet, and when you hit with an unarmed strike, you deal an extra 2d6 slashing damage.
Pantera's Fury At 10th level, during your Resurrección, your speed doubles, and you can take the Dash action as a bonus action. Additionally, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one additional attack.
Garra de la Pantera At 13th level, your Desgarrón claws improve. The extra damage increases to 3d6, and your critical hit range with unarmed strikes increases to 19-20. When you score a critical hit, you can immediately make one additional unarmed strike as part of the same action.
Gran Rey Cero Desgarrador At 17th level, your Gran Rey Cero tears through reality. When you use it, you can choose to shape it into a 60-foot line instead of a sphere. The line ignores cover and deals slashing damage. A creature that fails its saving throw is also affected as if by the *disintegrate* spell if it has 50 hit points or fewer.

sub.n: Aspect of Intoxication (Séptima Espada: Zommari Rureaux)
sub.d:
Amor's Gaze At 3rd level, as an action, you can target one creature within 60 feet that can see you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute. While charmed, you can issue simple commands (no more than a sentence) on your turn, which it will obey if it understands. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.
Brujería At 6th level, you can use Amor's Gaze on a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) with a single action. Additionally, as an action, you can spend 15 Reiryoku to attempt to dominate a creature's limbs. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or you control its movement and actions on its next turn. It can repeat the save at the end of its turn.
Gemelos Sonído Supremo At 10th level, your Gemelos Sonído creates up to four duplicates. A creature must roll a 16 or higher to target the real you. When a duplicate is destroyed, it explodes in a 5-foot radius, dealing 2d8 force damage.
Ojo Omnipotente At 13th level, you can cast *dominate person* once per long rest without spending Reiryoku, using Charisma. Creatures have disadvantage on the initial saving throw if they are already charmed by your Amor's Gaze.
Ultimate Arrogance At 17th level, your belief in your perfection is a shield. You gain a +3 bonus to AC. …

sub.n: Aspect of Madness (Octava Espada: Szayelaporro Granz)
sub.d:
Gabriel's Eye At 3rd level, as a bonus action, you can analyze a creature within 60 feet. You learn its current hit points, immunities, resistances, vulnerabilities, and any active spell effects on it. Once per turn, when you hit a creature you've analyzed, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage of a type it is vulnerable to, or force it to make a saving throw against one of its own abilities.
Forbidden Archive At 6th level, when a creature you can see uses a spell or feature, you can use your reaction to spend Reiryoku equal to the spell's level (or 5 for a feature) and make a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, you copy the ability and can use it once within the next hour, using your own DC/attack bonus.
Virus de la Marioneta At 10th level, you can inject a spiritual virus. As an action, make a melee spell attack against a creature. On a hit, it takes 4d6 poison damage and is infected. An infected creature has disadvantage on saving throws against your features. As a bonus action, you can force an infected creature to move up to its speed or make one weapon attack against itself or an ally.
Regeneración de Datos At 13th level, your Biological Reconstruction works on information. If you die, your consciousness is backed up in a remote "egg" you prepared during a long rest. A new body forms there over 1d4 days. You can only have one such egg at a time. …

sub.n: Aspect of Greed (Novena Espada: Aaroniero Arruruerie)
sub.d:
Glotonería At 3rd level, when you reduce a humanoid or monstrosity to 0 hit points, you can devour its soul as a bonus action. You permanently gain one of its traits: a skill proficiency, a language, a movement speed, or a special sense (like blindsight 30 ft.). You can retain a number of traits equal to your Charisma modifier.
Metamorfosis At 6th level, you can perfectly mimic the form and voice of any creature whose soul you've devoured. As an action, you can also spend 10 Reiryoku to assume the form and one signature combat ability (DM's discretion) of a devoured creature for 10 minutes.
Ánfora de Almas At 10th level, you store devoured souls. You can hold a number of souls equal to your proficiency bonus. As an action, you can release one to ask it a question, as per the *speak with dead* spell. Alternatively, you can consume a stored soul to regain 5d10 hit points or 20 Reiryoku.
Espada del Devorado At 13th level, you can manifest the Zanpakutō of a devoured Shinigami soul. You gain proficiency with it and can use its Shikai ability once per long rest. The DM determines the ability's power.
Hive of a Thousand Souls At 17th level, as an action, you unleash stored souls in a 60-foot cone. Each creature must make a Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 12d10 psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute as voices overwhelm its mind. On a success, half damage. Once used, you lose all stored souls and can't use Glotonería for 24 hours.

sub.n: Aspect of Rage (Décima Espada: Yammy Llargo)
sub.d:
Accumulating Ire At 3rd level, when you take damage, you gain 1 Ire point (max = Espada level). As a bonus action, spend any number to increase the damage of your next melee attack by +1d8 per point spent.
Ira Form At 6th level, your size increases to Large when you enter Resurrección. Your weapon damage dice increase by one size, and you can grapple creatures up to Huge size.
Ultra Regeneration At 10th level, when you use Biological Reconstruction, you can spend Ire points instead of Regeneration Dice. While below half your HP, you regain Reiryoku equal to your Con modifier at the start of each turn.
Gran Cuerpo At 13th level, your size increases to Huge when your Ire points are at maximum. Your reach increases by 5 feet, and you deal double damage to objects and structures.
Cero Ira At 17th level, when you use Gran Rey Cero, you can channel all Ire points into it. For every 5 points spent, increase its damage by 2d12 and its radius by 10 feet. If you spend 20+ points, it also knocks creatures prone.
Former Espada & Privaron Espada Arrancars who once held the rank of Espada but were demoted are known as Privaron Espada (Fallen Blades). They are marked with three-digit numbers (e.g., 103, 105) and, while no longer among the top ten, their power still far exceeds that of regular Numeros. …

731.d: These are additional levels for the Barbarian class. See Level 40 Expansion (5e Variant Rule) for more info.
f: Demigod

At 21st level, you begin to surpass the capabilities of regular mortals as you slowly become godlike, emulating the things that make you a barbarian and transforming you into a minor deity in your own right. You’re creature type changes from humanoid to celestial, but you keep your subtype (i.e human or dragonborn). In addition, features and effects that normally can’t increase your ability scores above 20 can now increase your ability scores to a maximum of 24 instead, and your Strength and Constitution scores can be increased to a maximum of 28. …
Improved Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 23rd level, and again at 28th and 34th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 3, or you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2 and another ability score of your choice by 1, or you can increase three ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can’t increase an ability score above 24 with this feature.
Blind Rage

At 25th level, you can choose to go into a blind rage whenever you rage. When you enter a blind rage, choose a creature you can see. While in a blind rage, your rage damage bonus is doubled, you roll an additional d20 when you make a melee weapon attack and can choose either result as the roll, and you are considered blinded and deafened in regards to your surroundings except for your target and the area directly between you and your target. If that creature becomes incapacitated, you may select a new creature to be the target of your blind rage. …
Leaping Run

Starting at 27th level, every step you take while running launches you forward as though you were leaping. Your speed increases by 5 feet, and when you take the Dash action for the first time on your turn your speed increases by an additional 10 feet. You also automatically succeed on Strength checks made to jump over hurdles and gaps if you took the Dash action before making the jump.
Thick Skinned
Starting at 29th level, you reduce all incoming damage except for psychic damage by 5. This feature cannot reduce the damage to less than 1.
Insistent Rage

Starting at 33rd level, you have advantage on saving throws for your Relentless Rage feature. The DC for the save is reduced by half, rounded down, after determining what the current DC is for how many times you have used that feature since your last long rest. You also ignore the first 5 levels of exhaustion while raging. However, you gain 1 level of exhaustion each time you use your Relentless Rage feature while the DC for it is above 20.
Dormant Rage

Beginning at 36th level, you never truly stop raging. Going into a normal rage requires no action by you and can be done as a reaction to when you are hit by an attack or put in the area of a damaging spell or effect, but other rages, such as a blind rage, still require you to use a bonus action to enter. In addition, ending a rage requires no action by you. Entering a rage as a reaction happens before any damage is dealt.
Primal Power

At 37th level, your connection to your inner anger boosts your physical attributes, granting you strength beyond compare. Both your current and maximum Strength and Constitution scores each increase by 4, to a maximum of 30; you are immune to being physically grappled, restrained, or knocked prone; and you can use melee weapons and the features of melee weapons that normally require two hands with only one hand.
Godly Strength

At 39th level, you have reached the pinnacle of physical prowess attainable by most beings, both mortal and divine. Your carrying capacity (including maximum lift and maximum load) is doubled. The minimum you can roll for a Strength check is equal to your Strength score plus your Strength modifier. Your melee weapon attacks ignore any and all resistances to damage that they would deal. Your carrying capacity (including maximum lift and maximum load) does not change when you shrink in size. …
Might of the Gods

At 40th level, your transformation from mortal to god is complete. Your DM will grant you one boon from the list of Epic Boons in the Dungeon Master’s Guide after taking suggestions from you. In addition, your base size increases to that of a Huge creature (or Gargantuan if your base size is Large or larger), and as an action you can shrink to the size of a Medium creature until you choose to use an action to enlarge yourself back to your normal size. …
Path of the Berserker

Fanatical Bloodlust Starting at 22nd level, when you go into a frenzied rage, you can choose to go into a fanatical frenzied rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you are in a frenzied rage and you can make one melee weapon attack during each of your turns (no action required), and if you deal sufficient damage with an attack to reduce a creature to 0 hit points you must choose another …
Path of the Totem Warrior

Totemic Embodiment At 22nd level, you gain a magical benefit based on the totem animal you chose at 14th level.
Bear.
The spirit of the bear roars inside of you, granting you the abilities gained at 14th level even while you aren’t raging.
Eagle.
The spirit of the eagle soars inside of you, increasing your fly speed while raging by 30 feet.
Wolf. …
Path of the Zealot

Celestial Anger At 22nd Level, your anger during rage has become so great that you can destroy lesser foes in a single strike. You now add 1d6 + half your barbarian level to all attacks, regardless of whether it was the first attack or not. This damage will be either necrotic or radiant, chosen when you got this feature at 3rd level. …
Path of the Ancestral Guardian

Spiritual Defenders At 22nd level, you have gained an unbreakable connection with your ancestral spirits. They can now not only hinder your foes, but also protect your allies. The total damage dealt by your first target last turn is now reduced by 10, increasing to 20 at 35th level. You cannot reduce damage to below 1 with this feature. …

738.d: This is an expansion to the Murder Class, and was made using the Level 40 Expansion 5e Variant Rule
f: The Embodiment of Murder

Starting at 21st level, you begin to transcend the old definition of Murder. Your Creature Type changes to Fiend, but you keep your subtype (i.e human or dragonborn). In addition, Features and effects that normally can’t increase your Ability Scores above 20 can now increase your Ability Scores up to a maximum of 24 instead. You will gain double Proficiency on a Weapon of your choice (It can't be an improvised weapon or your unarmed strikes).
From this point on, your physical features slowly change as you gain levels in this Class. …
Improved Ability Score Improvement

Starting at 23rd level, and again at 25th, 28th, 31st, and 34th level, you can increase one Ability Score of your choice by 3, or you can increase one Ability Score of your choice by 2 and another Ability Score of your choice by 1, or you can increase three Ability Scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can’t increase an Ability Score above 24 with this feature.
Fine Leather Upgrade
Starting at 25th level, your AC while wearing a mask or an hat made of flesh increases by 1 and if you don't have any your Charisma increases by 2 instead.
Beyond The Violence
Starting at 26th level, you can roll one additional Damage Die on every Attack.
Feral Instinct Upgrade
Starting at 29th level, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to your Initiative.
Violent Reaction
Starting at 32nd level, you can Attack a creature as a Reaction. This Attack will always count as a Critical Hit.
Extra Attack
Starting at 33rd level, you can Attack five times, instead of four, whenever you take an Attack on your turn.
Finishing Fracture and Death Sentence Upgrade

Starting at 36th level, Spine Breaker and Neck Breaker will deal double Damage.
Death Sentence will also store an additional Murder Die bonus for each Attack made.
Apogee of the Intent to Murder
Starting at 37th level, your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores each increase by 2, to a maximum of 30; one other This material is published under the OGL 1.0a.

sub.d:
Starting at 24th level, you gain one of the effects listed below: d4 1 Miasma - When you finish Attacking a creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw of DC 8 + your Attack Roll Modifier or become Paralyzed and frightened until the start of its next Turn.
2 Damage Apogee - Once every Turn, you can make one of your Attacks deal his maximum possible Damage.
3 Deathframe - During an Action, you can add your unused Speed to the Damage of one of your Attacks. …
f: Brutal Critical

Starting at 24th level, you can roll four additional Weapon dice when determining the extra Damage of a critical hit with a melee Attack. The effect increases to five additional dice at 31st level and six additional dice at 38th level.

sub.d:
Six abilities provide a quick description of every creature's physical and mental characteristics:
Strength, measuring physical power Dexterity, measuring agility Constitution, measuring endurance Intelligence, measuring reasoning and memory Wisdom, measuring perception and insight Charisma, measuring force of personality Is a character muscle-bound and insightful? Brilliant and charming? Nimble and hardy? Ability scores define these qualities—a creature's assets as well as weaknesses.
The three main rolls of the game–the ability check, the saving throw, and the attack roll —rely on the six ability scores. …

Six abilities provide a quick description of every creature's physical and mental characteristics:
Strength, measuring physical power Dexterity, measuring agility Constitution, measuring endurance Intelligence, measuring reasoning and memory Wisdom, measuring perception and insight Charisma, measuring force of personality Is a character muscle-bound and insightful? Brilliant and charming? Nimble and hardy? Ability scores define these qualities—a creature's assets as well as weaknesses. …
f: The Embodiment of Pure Violence Upgrade
Starting at 38th level, you can choose another effect from The Embodiment of Pure Violence list.
Divine Genocide

At 40th level, your transformation fis complete. Your DM will grant you one boon from the list of Epic Boons in the Dungeon Master’s Guide after taking suggestions from you. In addition, you may make a Attack on each of your Turns (no action required by you). You also gain sufficient power to commit a divine genocide, beginning your ascent to to transcend the sense of murder itself.
Murder Archetype Feature
Butcher
Brutality Hunger Upgrade

Starting at 22nd level, when you eat the flesh of a creature, you can gain one of his Ability Scores, one of his Racial Abilities or one of his Proficiency Bonuses. You can permanently store a maximum number of abilities equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Meat Bastion
Starting at 27th level, your enemies will find it much harder to hurt you. You can use your Reaction to roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, the Attack instead does not damage you., Regardless of its roll.
Butcher's Colossal Strenght

Starting at 30th level, you count as one Size larger and you can wield even bigger melee Weapons increasing your reach by an additional 5 feet. Your melee Weapons deal double the base Weapon dice Damage (1d4 becomes 2d4, 1d12 becomes 2d12). Their cost and their weight will also double being more difficult to forge, so much so that a a blacksmith or an artificier would take twice as long to make a …
Anyone should Bleed

Starting at 35th level, you can make anything Bleed. You can apply your Hemorrhage Feature to any creature regardless of when he has blood in his body or not. On a hit, a creature can't regain Hit Points until the start of your next Turn.
Skinning Strike

Starting at 39th level, twice every Short or Long Rest, when your hook is stuck inside a creature, you can use your Bonus Action to skin the targeted creature in one strike. The creature must pass a Constitution Saving Throw of DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier with Disadvantage. On a fail, the creature takes 30d10 Force and Necrotic Damage but you take 1 level of Exhaustion. …
Clown

757.d: Though not typically thought of as a warrior or adventurer, working in the field all day when the sun is hot and high in the sky certainly makes a person far tougher than most. A fight against one of these individuals is sure to be a long one that not many can endure.
f: Tools of the Trade

As a Farmer, there are some tools you simply know how to utilize better than anyone. When using a Sickle, the damage die for the weapon is a 1d6 rather than a 1d4. In addition, you can use a Pitchfork as a weapon.
You are also proficient whenever setting up hunting traps, or disarming them.
Pitchfork A weapon that only Farmers use. A pitchfork is a two-handed weapon that deals 1d10 piercing damage and can be thrown (range 30/80ft). You are proficient with this weapon.
Out-Endure Them

You might not be the heaviest hitter or the burliest fighter out there but toiling away in the fields all day has taught you a thing or two about endurance. At 1st level, you gain Endurance Dice, seen in the chart above.
As a bonus action, you can expend any number of Endurance Dice, you then gain 1d6 + your Constitution modifier worth of temporary hit points per die for 4 hours. You regain all expended Endurance Dice after completing a Long Rest.
The die increases to 1d8 at 6th level, 1d10 at 10th level, 1d12 at 15th level and 2d8 at 20th level. …
Reap What You Sow

Some features will ask for a bleed save which is a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier You know life’s not all about getting what you want right away; all things take time and dedication. This mindset shows through your fighting style. At 2nd level, when you make a successful attack against a creature you can have them make a bleed save. If they fail the save, then at the beginning of each of their turns they take half your level (rounded down) in necrotic (bleeding) damage. …
Paths of the Farmer
At 3rd level, you choose to go down the path of the Fieldhand or Reaper.
Ability Score Increase

When you reach 4th level, and again at 6th, 8th, 12th, 14th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can’t increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Using the optional feats rule, you can forgo taking this feature to take a feat of your choice instead.
Extra Attack (to be switched with something else)
Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
Beast Foe

You’ve had to deal with your fair share of beasts, and it shows. At 5th level, Intimidation checks made against beasts are done with advantage. Attack and damage rolls you make against beasts gain a +1 bonus, and you can use your action to force a beast within 30ft to make a Wisdom save against 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. If they fail the save they use their reaction to move their speed away from you and are frightened of you for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the creature may reroll the saving throw to end the effect. …
Landtender

Working with nature has made you incredibly familiar with it. As such, you can get the most out of it and know how to traverse it. At 7th level, choose either Survival or Nature to gain proficiency in the skill. If you are already proficient, double your proficiency modifier and when you make skill checks with either to gather food, herbal ingredients, identify ingredients, you do so with advantage.
You also treat any difficult terrain not created magically as normal terrain.
Live Off the Land

Tending the land is hungry work, so you’ve learned to really appreciate whatever you manage to get your hands on. At 7th level, you are able to drink potions as a bonus action. In addition, you can now use an action to consume food (1 ration) and regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your Constitution modifier. once you have done so you cannot regain hit points from this feature until you complete a short or long rest.
The hit points you regain increases to 3d8 + your Constitution modifier at 11th level, 4d8 at 15th level, and 5d8 at 19th level.
Get ‘Em By the Roots

Plants? People? They’ve both got one thing in common: get them by their roots and they’ll go down. At 9th level, when you hit a creature no more than one size larger than you with an attack, you can choose to make an Uprooting Strike. In addition to the normal effects, the target must make a Dexterity save against your bleed save DC or be knocked prone.
You must be wielding a sickle or pitchfork to use this ability.
If you choose to make a attack an Uprooting Strike then it cannot be a Precise Cut, a Disabling Wound attack or a Heart Carving Strike
One With the Earth

You have become as solid as the ground you tend. At 11th level, any attempts to knock you prone or move you against your will are done with disadvantage and you have advantage to resist such attempts. This feature is not active when your character is not touching the ground (for instance, if they are affected by a Fly spell).
You also treat all difficult terrain as normal terrain.
Careful Eye and Quick Hands

Days of watching your fields and keeping beasts out have made you a cautious one. At 13th level, you gain proficiency in Perception. If you already have proficiency in this skill, double the proficiency bonus for it. You can no longer be surprised by enemies so long as you are conscious. Lastly, you have advantage on Initiative rolls.
If you have or gain the Alert feat, you add an additional +2 to your passive perception and gain 10ft blindsense
Precise Cuts

Knowing just where to cut for your crops has started to transition over to fighting your enemies. At 15th level, you can use your bonus action when you hit a creature to make it a Precise Cut attack. In addition the normal effects, your target must make a bleed save. If they fail then you manage to cripple them and their movement speed is now halved. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
You can only use this feature a number of times equal to your Strength modifier, regaining spent uses after completing a long rest. …
Disabling Wounds

You’re getting even better at making just the right sort of attacks to hinder your enemies in the worst of ways. At 17th level, you can use your bonus action when you hit with an Attack to make it a Disabling Wound attack. In addition the normal effects, your target must make a bleed save. If they fail then you manage to make their attacks less effective. Their weapon attacks, unarmed strikes, and natural weapon attacks are made with disadvantage. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. …
Heart Carver

If you want to cut something down, you should go for the core. And that’s exactly what you do. At 18th level, you can use your bonus action when you hit with an Attack to make it a Heart Carving Strike. In addition to the normal effects, they make a bleed save. If they succeed, they gain the bleed effect from your “Reap What You Sow” feature as if they failed the saving throw against that feature. On a failure, they take bleed damage equal to twice your level at the beginning of each of their turns. …

sub.d:
From working away endlessly in the fields all day, you’ve become a pretty sturdy individual who can endure quite a lot. Those that face you know they’re in for a long and grueling fight.
Sturdy Build You’ve withstood a lot of toil, so it takes quite a bit to take you down. At 3rd level, you gain 6 hit points, and 2 hit points for every time you gain a level in the farmer class.
Hardworking Kinsmanship Your humble profession and clear hardworking ethic makes you easily relate to your fellow common man. At 6th level, any Persuasion (Charisma) checks you make when talking to a fellow commoner/peasant are done with advantage. Furthermore, if you spend at least a day assisting them with their own farm work, they will normally reward you with at least 1d6 rations or equivalent and lodgings.
Sheer Determination There aren’t as many who are quite so devoted and motivated as you are to completing a task. At 10th level, you can spend Two Endurance die to add your Constitution modifier to a skill check, attack roll, or saving throw, after you roll but before you know the results.
Death Defying Stubbornness You’re already so used to taking a beating from your typical profession; no way are you going to let someone knock you down so easily. At 14th level, when you drop to zero hit points, you can spend an Endurance die without using an action and regain hit points instead of temporary hit points. You can use this feature once, regaining the use after completing a short or long rest. …

You’re used to being completely dug into your work and disappearing into the crops you harvest. Cuts you make are precise and carefully thought out to make the most of what you reap, and this has transferred over to your fighting style.
The Scarecrow Countless days spent working in the thick of the fields has made you used to working silently and often going unnoticed. Unless you’re scaring off some pest who’s snuck into your domain. At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Stealth. If you are already proficient in Stealth, then double your proficiency bonus. If you are traveling through a field or someplace similar, then you make the roll with advantage.
In addition, you are capable of performing a Scarecrow Strike if you manage to attack an enemy without them being aware of your presence. For a Scarecrow Strike you gain advantage on your attack to hit when coming out of stealth like normal. But in addition if you manage to hit, then your target must make a Charisma save against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your charisma modifier. Should they fail, then they are rattled by your sudden appearance. All attacks made against the target are done so with advantage until the beginning of the target’s turn and the target is frightened of you for 1 minute.
You must be wielding a sickle or pitchfork to use this ability.
Light Feet You’ve actually gotten pretty good with this whole hiding thing, and maneuvering around your fields has made you a lot more careful with your footing. …

796.d: Long ago, there lived a greater deity, called Nicholas the Everfrozen. A multitude of ice elves venerated him in his domain, located on the Frostfell, quasi-elemental plane of ice. But his biggest group of followers were children across the multiverse, for Nicholas delighted in creating simple, yet enjoyable toys, which he proceeded to give to well-behaved children. …
f: Delivering COAL

Old Saint Nick wishes to bestow COAL upon his enem-... upon those on his Naughty List. Your attacks channel the power of Christmas itself into your opponent, making them feel as if they just received a lump of Frozen Coal on Christmas Morning. Beginning at 1st level, once per turn, when you hit an enemy with melee attack you can deal additional cold damage equal to 1d4. If a creature takes this cold damage, it cannot take the dash or disengage action until the end of its next turn, as great chills bind it. …
Northern Fortitude
Chill is just a part of you. Starting as 1st level, you naturally acclimate to extremely cold climates. Additionally, you gain resistance to cold damage.
Naughty List

This goes without saying. Starting at 1st level you can cast Detect Evil and Good spell, requiring no components a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Cookies

You like sweets, but who does not? Starting at 2nd level you can use your cook's utensils to make delicious cookies out of ordinary ingredients like eggs, flour, love, milk and sugar. As a part of the long rest, you can make a number of cookies equal to your proficiency modifier, and any unconsumed cookies you made spoil when you make the new batch. You can use your bonus action to eat a cookie or force-feed another willing or unconscious creature. Creature eating a cookie regains 2d4 + your proficiency bonus hit points. …
Santa's List

At 3rd level, you formalize your sacred duty through your Naughty and Nice List, which defines how you judge the multiverse. This feature grants you abilities at 3rd level and then scales with other features that interact with your COAL and Cookies as you gain levels.
Naughty List.
As a bonus action, you can choose one creature you can see within 60 feet and designate it as Naughty for 1 minute. This does not require concentration. While a creature is marked as Naughty:
Once per turn, when you hit it with a melee attack, you deal additional COAL damage equal to your COAL dice. …
Santa Path

At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you better inpersonate, choosing from Christmas Spirit and Winter Father, both described at the end of this class' description. Your archetype choice grants you features at 3rd level and then again at 6th, 11th, and 17th level.
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Extra Attack
At 5th level you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
Down The Chimney

Your ability to defy the laws of geometry grows. At 5th level, you can move through a hostile creature’s space regardless of it's size and can squeeze through passages as narrow as 8 inches wide, both vertical or horizontal.
At 10th level you gain resistance to falling damage.
Rudolf

Starting at 5st level you can cast Find steed spell, summoning only elk. When you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.
At 10th level you can summon giant elk instead.
Christmas Gifts

Starting at 7th level, your mystical connection to your battle prowess manifests in most peculiar way. You can create simple, harmless, mundane objects that could be described as toys. You can produce those toys from any closed container by just reaching your hand inside and thinking of a specific person, then the toy is produced in shape and working appealing to the subconscious desires of the person you though about. …
First Star
Starting at 9th level, a lonely star provides you with enough light to see the path you walk. You gain darkvision up to 60 feet while in dim light and total darkness, either mundane or magical.
COAL Burns

Not only a saddening feeling COAL can bring, it can also burn. Starting at 13th level, whenever you deal your COAL damage, you can swap the damage type to fire, and if a creature takes this fire damage it is blinded until the end of its next turn. Additionally you gain immunity to cold damage.
Creator of Joy
Your powers grow at a rapid rate. Starting at 14th level, you can cast the Fabricate spell without expending a spell slot.
Northen Pole

Your strength start to manifest on great scale. Starting at 15th level, when you are standing on a snow, as a bonus action you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also covered in snow. You then have advantage on the first melee attack you make before the end of the turn.
Additionally, you can cast control weather spell once, and you regain the ability to do so after you finish a long rest. When you cast this spell you can change weather conditions regardless of the current conditoins, provided you change them by increasing their stage. …
Powerful COAL

Starting at 18th Level, your ability to use COAL is so great, it takes but a mere thought to activate. When you can see a creature within 30 feet of you take damage, you can use your reaction to add your COAL damage to the damage this creature takes. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier, and regain all spent uses after you finish a long rest.
Living Saint

Starting at 20th level, you reach the peak of your ability, your soul projecting your sainthood around you. You are permanently under the effects of Resistance and Protection from Evil and Good spells, which cannot be dispelled.

sub.d: You embody the spirit of christmas, burn with desire to bestow gifts to others and watch them smile, stay to protect them and help carry the burden of their everyday lives.
f: Jolly
Starting at 3rd level, you gain advantage on Charisma skill checks, provided you are not in combat.
Hand-made Protectors

Starting at 6th level, you can make a number of totems equal to your proficiency modifier. Those totems resemble toys, and you can give them to any creature of your choice. When a friendly creature have this totem on them and take damage, you can use your reaction and roll COAL dice to reduce the damage this creature take by the amount rolled(you cannot reduce damage below 0), provided that creatu …
Warm of Heart

Your ever-encompassing love takes form of small, incorporeal creatures with pointy hats, that follow you wherever you go, and portect whoever you choose. Starting at 11th level, each creature that recieved your totem from Hand-made Protector feature gain the following benefits: those creatures become naturally acclimated to extremely cold climates. …
Ho ho ho!

Starting at 17th level, as a part of summoning your elk or giant elk with your Rudolf feature, you can materialize great, wooden sleigh. This construction has 100 hit points, resistance to all damage, AC of 18 and can fit up to 6 medium creatures. Your elk can pull this sleigh effortlessly, provided no more than 2000 pounds are loaded on them. …

sub.d: You are the embodiment of howling winds of antarctica, resilient like an iceberg and ready to stand againt anything in your path like a force of nature you are.
f: Frost Aura

Starting at 3rd level, you emanate a chill, magical aura that extends 10 feet from you in every direction, but not through total cover. You can use your bonus action to stop or start its effects. Every hostile creature that enters your aura or starts its turn there takes 2 cold damage each. …
Icy Skin
A mass of white ice covers your body, protecting and cooling you down. Starting at 6th level, you gain resistance to fire damage, and your AC increases by 1 when you are not wearing heavy armor.
Breath of Frost

A raging storm settled in your lungs, waiting to be unleashed. Starting at 11th level, you can cast Cone of Cold spell, requiring no components.
Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell. When you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.
At 15th level, you can use this feature twice between long rests.
Song of Ice and COAL

Your body like unstoppable ice berg, your eyes like embers, your strength knows no bounds. Starting at 17th level, when dealing fire and ice damage, you ignore resistance to those damage types. Your aura increases in size to 30 feet and when you deal cold damage to a creature, its speed is reduced by 30 feet(to a minimum of 0 feet) until the end of its next turn.

801.d:
“ There is power in the Blood, for those with the fortitude to pay the price. ” — The Ancestor.
The Flagellant is a zealous dogmatic individual who harnesses power from his/her own suffering and anguish. These men and women have essentially weaponized their own physical and mental anguish as they seek martyrdom, their strikes bleeding out the blood of their foes while they also bleed out their own body to heal their …
f: Rapturous

Starting at 1st level, your zealotry and fanaticism change fear into a frenetic state. Whenever you fail a saving throw against the charmed or frightened condition, you don't become frightened. Instead, you enter in a rapturous state, gaining the following benefits:
You add your suffering die to your damage rolls.
Your movement speed increases in 10 feet.
All attack rolls against you are made at advantage.
At the start of your turn, roll a d4. On a 1, you act normally. On a 2, you attack the closest enemy you can reach with your movement. …
Blessing of Martyrdom

Starting at 1st level, whenever you take damage and are left with 0 hit points by a hostile creature, all allied creatures within 30 feet regain hit points equal to your Flagellant level. In addition, you don't fall unconscious or incapacitated while at 0 hit points. You still roll Death saving throws, but you can take your turns as normal.
Moreover, you gain the following benefits while at 0 hit points:
You have advantage on attack rolls you make.
Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws they make against your Flagellant class features.
Your speed increases by 10 feet. …
Instruments of Devotion

Also at 1st level, you start to bear the true instruments of devotion: the whip that flails your own flesh, and the flesh upon the pain is delivered.
Hand-Fashioned Flail Your attacks with the whip or the flail score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20 on the d20, and you can roll your suffering die in place of the normal damage for your attacks with a whip or flail.
Sinner's Flesh While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield, your Armor Class equals 10 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.
Punish

Starting at 2nd level, you can lash the sinners to punish them for their transgressions. Whenever you hit a creature with a whip or flail, you can force that creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target starts to bleed. If you score a critical hit on an attack using a flail or whip, the creature automatically starts to bleed, without making a save.
A bleeding target takes necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns equal to a roll of your suffering die for 1 minute. …
Painful Ecstasy

Also at 2nd level, whenever you have half your maximum hit points or lower, you gain a bonus equal to your suffering die to your damage rolls. You only deal this additional damage once per turn.
In addition, you score critical hits on a 19-20 on the d20. If you are using a whip or flail, you score critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20.
Finally, you add your Suffering die to your initiative rolls.
Flagellant's Path
Starting at 3rd Level, you commit yourself to a Flagellant's Path. Your path grants you features at the 3rd, 6th, and 14th Level.
Lash's Cure
Starting at 3rd level, you can purge the foulness from your sacred flesh. You can spend one hit die during a short or a long rest to remove a disease from your body.
Lash's Anger
Starting at 5th level, you can use your action to enter in your Rapturous state even without a negative condition affecting you, lasting for 1 minute.
Implements of Faith

Starting at 5th level, your ability to deliver and endure pain grows further.
Initiate's Flail You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action with a whip or flail on your turn. In addition, your attacks with whips and flails count as magical for the purposes of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
Lacerated Flash While not wearing armor, you gain resistance to slashing damage.
Trinkets of Suffering
Starting at 6th level, you can choose two trinkets from the Trinkets list bellow. You gain one additional trinket at 10th, 14th and 18th levels.
Lash's Kiss

At 7th level, the pain of the lash on your body is tender as a kiss of a lover. As a bonus action, you can lash yourself and roll a hit die. You regain hit points equal to the number rolled and the poisoned condition ends on you.
Lash's Solace
At 7th level, you find comfort in pain. You can use your action and spend 1 hit die to remove one negative condition affecting you. If you are under the effect of Rapturous, that effect also ends.
Unyielding

Starting at 9th level, you can add your suffering die to the result of your Death saving throws. If doing so increases your result to 20 or higher, you gain the benefits of rolling 20 on the saving throw.
Implements of Pain

Starting at 11th level, the suffering becomes a close friend. You gain the following benefits:
Suffering Flail At 11th level, you deal additional damage equal to your suffering die to all your attacks with a whip or flail.
Scared Flesh At 11th level, whenever you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to be reduced to 1 hit point instead. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier, and regain your uses of this feature after a long rest.
In addition, you only die when you fail a number of Death Saving Throws equal to your proficiency bonus.
Last Gasp

At 13th level, while you are under half your maximum hit points, you gain an extra action on each of your turns. This action can only be used to take the attack (one weapon attack only), dash, or disengage actions.
Clutch Hitter
At 15th level, while you are below your hit point maximum, you deal additional damage equal to your Flagellant level on critical hits.
Implements of Martyrdom

At 17th level, you are closer to the path of purification. You gain the following benefits:
Bloodthirsty Flail Once per turn when you hit a creature with a flail or whip, you deal additional necrotic damage equal to your suffering die.
Martyr's Flesh You gain resistance to slashing, piercing and bludgeoning damage. In addition, you become immune to necrotic, or radiant damage.
Bloodied Saint

When you reach the 20th level, the scars and lacerations on your flesh have taken all the sin of your soul. You gain the following benefits:
The Burden You score critical hits on a roll of 17-20 with the flail or whip.
The Testament You gain resistance to all damage types, except psychic. You become immune to poison damage, the poisoned condition and disease.
Trinkets

Heartburst Hood Whenever you are below half your maximum hit points, your speed increases by 10 feet and you add your Constitution modifier to your Initiative rolls.
Resurrection's Collar Whenever you cause a creature other than yourself to regain hit points with your Flagellant features, you add your suffering die to the amount of hit points gained by that creature.
Punishment's Hood Whenever you are under half your maximum hit points, you cause additional damage equal to your suffering die with your attacks with the lash or whip. You only cause this additional damage once per turn. …
Path of Punishment

Rain of Sorrows Starting at 3rd level, whenever you hit a creature with an attack from a whip or flail, you can choose to halve the damage and target one additional creature within 5 feet of the first target and within reach. If the original result would also hit that creature's AC, this attack also hits. …
Path of Sacrifice

Reclaim Starting at 3rd level, as an action, you can cause yourself to bleed, as if you had been targeted by the Punish feature. For the duration, you can cause one creature of your choice other than yourself to regain hit points equal to the necrotic damage taken by you from the bleeding effect.
While bleeding in this manner, you regain 1 hit point at the start of each of your turns. …

837.d: Fueled by a powerful desire to mete out justice, crush worthy foes, or simply bathe in the blood of unsuspecting victims, Furserkers are convicted warriors who wield great power and speed granted to them by their bestial blood, alongside temperance of their body through rigorous training methods that are nothing short of astounding. …
f: Unyielding Assailant
You have trained your body to an astounding level of durability. Beginning at 1st level, you can calculate your AC using your Constitution modifier rather than your Dexterity modifier.
Furred One's Might

You are adept at rushing the enemy and striking before they can react. Also at 1st level, your melee attacks deal an additional damage 1d4 if you have moved at least 15 feet before attacking. This effect increases to two additional damage dice at 6th level, three additional damage dice at 11th level, and four additional damage dice at 17th level.
Bestial Fury

You are able to unleash the fury of your beast blood against any attackers. Beginning at 2nd level, upon taking damage, you can use your reaction to make two attacks against the foe, one with your weapon, and one with an unarmed strike. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses upon taking a Long Rest.
Savage Styles

At 3rd level, you have honed your abilities keenly, but in order to further strengthen oneself with efficaciousness, you will need to focus your talents on a particular style. Choose between the Feral Warrior, the Furtive Predator, and the Rakish Alpha, all detailed at the end of the class description. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level, and again at 7th level, 10th level, 15th level, and 18th level.
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action.
The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 13th level in this class.
Harsh Practice

You have endured strenuous training sufficient to kill the average person, and your body has accustomed to the constant strain. Starting at 9th level, you treat accumulated Exhaustion as if it were one level lower.
Additionally, when you suffer Disadvantage on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can choose to disregard it. You must take a Long Rest before you can use this feature again.
Honed Instincts
You have honed your senses to a fine point, and the speed at which you can react is incredible. Upon reaching 14th level, you can take two Reaction every round.
Wrath of the Hirsute

You have reached the highest echelon of physical prowess, a level that others could only dream of. Beginning at 20th level, your Strength and Dexterity scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.
Additionally, your damage dealt with melee weapons increases by an amount equal to your Strength.

sub.d:
While most Furserkers combine instinctual fury with combat expertise, some forgo the pursuit of the latter, focusing solely on annihilating any opposition with their fierce bestial strength. These Furserkers undergo a different type of training, tossing aside finesse and discipline to eliminate those that would attempt to harm them or their allies.
Ferocity Your path is one of blood and steel, and you fight with reckless abandon. Beginning at 3rd level, your damage with melee weapons increases by a number equal to double your Proficiency Bonus, and you suffer a penalty to your attack rolls equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
